title: Voice STT + background incoming calls
objective: Blyp home voice bar returns real transcripts/results instead of 'Couldn't hear you'. Incoming audio calls ring with full-screen notification when the app is backgrounded or killed, not only while the callee has Blyp open.
acceptanceCriteria: geminiProxy routes audio/STT payloads to Gemini (never OpenAI image_url mapping).
Android ships BlypCallMessagingService and call FCM is data-only high-priority so native IncomingCallModule can run when JS is dead.
Home voice failure messages distinguish auth/quota/empty-audio instead of a single opaque phrase.
Play AAB is built from committed sources at a new versionCode after these fixes.

analysts.responsibility: Confirm voice STT and background-call requirements are observable and complete.

builders.responsibility: Implement STT routing and native FCM call wake path.

reviewers.responsibility: Read-only review that the claimed root causes are actually fixed in the candidate.
